notes: The marginal Hebrew gloss was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
No interrogative morpheme stands in וְאַתָּה תִּנָּצֵל, so the fronted shalt is the verb's own (rule 17's first limit).
destroying ... utterly is kept whole with the hiphil of חרם, whose lexeme the bare English verb does not write (rule 44).
